interface.name: linura_protected_display_manager_v1
interface.description: Only the independently admitted protected owner may bind this global. A surface is neither a session lock nor authority to change a display. Control separately owns canonical approval, managed prepare and execution. The compositor suppresses ordinary presentation and input while a context is active, preserving the actual ext-session-lock state independently.

request.name: begin
request.description: BOOTTIME and wall-clock deadlines are supplied by the sealed Control challenge. Neither endpoint may reconstruct one clock's deadline from the remaining budget on the other clock, including after transport delay. Zero, expired, substituted or overlong bounds fail closed.

interface.name: linura_protected_display_interaction_v1
interface.description: Surface/input epochs and both kernel clocks bind one exact native scope. Neither readiness nor consumption authenticates a human, approves a plan, grants an executor permit, configures outputs or releases a session lock. A changed scope/input/focus/topology/configure or deadline invalidates proof. The owner must separately complete its purpose-bound native authentication.

request.name: refresh_presentation

description.summary: require a fresh presented revision on every output

request.description: Reconfigure all attached surfaces within the original scope and deadline. Input and old proof remain unavailable until every new configure has a matching independently completed native frame. This cannot retarget the scope, renew a deadline or rearm a consumed interaction.

request.name: begin_decision

description.summary: fresh decision within the original protected attempt

request.description: Only the retained consumed Apply scene can transition to a fresh Keep or Revert scope. Both absolute bounds must equal the original attempt's bounds. All required outputs receive new configure and presentation evidence; Apply input and frames cannot attest this decision. A second decision or any expired, replaced or abandoned context is denied.

request.name: begin_finalization

description.summary: fresh review over the retained original restoration

request.description: Only the still-held healthy Recovery scene may begin this separate purpose. Complete bounded LNRF material must match its actual original Root grant, restoration dispatch and current restored source/epoch. Material arrives in an immutable sealed file of at most 14 KiB. Pipes, mutable files and oversized content are denied before reading. New absolute wall/BOOTTIME bounds apply only to this review. They never renew restoration execution authority. All outputs require fresh owner frames. Consumption returns to fresh opaque native frames; it releases no startup, input, power, lock or original checkpoint protection.

request.name: quiesce_finalization

description.summary: retain protection while acknowledging native quiescence

request.description: Only the actual consumed terminal scene may consume this distinct original-Root channel. Complete reservation/material and current native source, epoch, KMS safety frames and input retirement must verify. A status reply remains nonterminal. No history or protection is released.

request.name: spend_native_release

description.summary: spend the original Root grant for a held first-frame handoff

request.description: This private original-owner request uses a distinct authenticated LNRS/LNRW Root channel and the exact Control version/digests in its immutable LNRN ancestry. On a successful spend the original Root records LNRX before acknowledgement. With the same live prepared terminal scene and fresh native/KMS guards, the compositor may then expose its first ordinary frames while retaining S17/input, power, original Root and startup admission fences. A status event acknowledges the attempt only: it is not physical proof or Control completion. No fence retirement is authorized here. This is single-use even on a failed or missing acknowledgement.

request.name: transfer_completion

description.summary: transfer the original live Root lifetime once

request.description: The authenticated original Root channel carries bounded LNCP material whose exact parent is this scene's previously spent LNRX. Its digest must equal Control's separately prepared completion. Fresh native/KMS evidence must still match every first-frame output and original clock bound. Root durably records LNCS and moves the live quiescence anchor before its one-use acknowledgement. The native recipient then admits only this same compositor invocation under that retained live Root lifetime, and quarantines input until fresh physical Escape and drain. S17, Root/native power and the global barrier for future startups stay held. Fresh post-effect verification and durable completion remain separate; this is not ReleasedCurrent. A failed or missing acknowledgement cannot permit another transfer.

interface.name: linura_protected_display_surface_v1

description.summary: one protected surface for one exact native output

interface.description: This assigns a private compositor role to an otherwise unassigned wl_surface of the same admitted client. Configure dimensions are bounded logical pixels. Committing a buffer is not proof of presentation. Native input stays gated until every required output has independently presented a protected frame.
